# Growth experiments

**Hypothesis to read-out: size tests properly, change one thing, use Trial Reels and ABAB schedules, stop on rules, log every result.**

Runs honest growth experiments for an AI influencer or creator account - turns ideas into scored hypotheses (ICE), sizes each test so the result means something (minimum detectable effect, posts or viewers per variant), picks a design (Instagram Trial Reels, YouTube Test & Compare, alternating ABAB schedules), changes one variable at a time, publishes variants through the approval flow, applies stop rules and guardrails, and writes a read-out with a decision. Use when someone asks "what should we test", wants to compare hooks, formats, posting times, captions or thumbnails, needs to know whether a change actually worked, or wants an experiment log and cadence. Never tests disclosure removal, bought engagement or other manipulation.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 30 min to design, 1–4 weeks to run | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Native split tests
2. Alternating schedules
3. Before/after with a holdout

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/growth-experiments.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/growth-experiments.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/growth-experiments.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/growth-experiments.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill growth-experiments`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `growth-experiments.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/growth-experiments`.
